 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(ones) != 1 or len(twos) != 1:
        return out
    r, c = ones[0]
    tr, tc = twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    nr, nc = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    # Follow a 45-degree run until one coordinate is one cell short,
    # then continue straight along the other axis, ending diagonally adjacent to 2.
    diagonal_steps = max(0, min(nr, nc) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if nr <= nc:
        while abs(tr-r) > 1:
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        while abs(tc-c) > 1:
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
